scope: Complete current production policy/PageMemory/archive/session-store, process route lease and navigation-policy classes plus verbatim AppPrefs, Gecko restore/intent ownership and route retention/retry helper methods/fields. Controlled Android/SQLite/SDK, protection/identity/owner/handler boundaries and real JVM workers/files. The time-zone collaborator is a counted synthetic default-system-ready boundary; custom or unready scope throws. It does not execute GeckoTimeZoneController, SDK time-zone APIs, Date or engine behavior. Constructor listener registration and teardown are explicit lifecycle adapters; only SDK restoreState/loadUri counters model native dispatch. Four compiled route counterfeits must fail their exact behavior. No actual Android SQLite, AtomicFile durability, Gecko native restore, network or live webpage claim.
